cards.text:
D-VS06/001EN
Circular Saw, Kiriel
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), if you have a protect marker on your circles, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and you get an Imaginary Gift: Protect.
[CONT](VC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000 for each protect marker on your circles.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose up to the same number of cards in your damage zone as the number of your (RC) with protect markers, and call them to (RC), and their [AUTO] abilities do not activate from this call. Then, for each card chosen in your damage zone, deal one damage to this unit.

D-VS06/002EN
Ammunition Angel
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) with protect marker or (VC), choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and you may put it to their damage zone face up. If you put, your opponent chooses a card from their damage zone, and heal it.
[CONT](RC):If there is a protect marker on this unit's circle, this unit gets [Power] +10000.

D-VS06/003EN
Beriberi Beat Angel
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], put the top card of your deck into your damage zone face up, choose a card from your damage zone, and call it to (RC).
[CONT](RC):If there is a protect marker on this unit's circle, this unit gets "Intercept" and "[AUTO]:When this unit intercepts, this unit gets [Shield] +5000 until end of that battle.", and can intercept from the back row.

D-VS06/004EN
Wild Shot Celestial, Raguel
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit is placed from hand, if a new card was put into your damage zone this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and call a card from your drop to (RC).

D-VS06/005EN
Nurse of Holdheart
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed from hand, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and swap a unit card from your hand with a card from your damage zone. If you put a grade 0 card into your damage zone, choose up to one of your opponent's rear-guards, put it into their damage zone, and if your opponent's rear-guard was put into their damage zone, your opponent chooses a card from their damage zone, and heals it. (Put the swapped cards face up)

D-VS06/006EN
Cure Basket Angel
Normal Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from hand], and draw a card.
[AUTO](RC):At the beginning of your opponent's battle phase, [COST][put this unit into your soul], choose two of your grade 1 or greater rear-guards, and until end of turn, they get "Intercept" and can intercept from the back row.

D-VS06/007EN
Transcendent Divider, Cassiel
Trigger Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 3｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 15000
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC) from hand, if you did not ride a grade 3 or greater unit this fight, perform one of the following.
・Choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
・Choose one of your opponent's units, and it gets [Critical] -2 until end of that battle.
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, if your damage zone has no cards, put the top card of your deck into your damage zone.

D-VS06/008EN
Revenger, Dragruler Phantom
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding on a unit with "Revenger" in its card name during the ride phase, search your deck for up to one card with "Revenger" in its card name, call it to (RC) and shuffle your deck. If your opponent's damage zone has four or less cards, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 "Illusionary Revenger, Mordred Phantom"], choose one of your opponent's vanguards, and deal one damage.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose all of your front row units with "Revenger" in its card names or "Blaster Dark", retire all of your other rear-guards, and for each rear-guard retired, all of your front row units gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If you retired two or more rear-guards, [Stand] all of your front row rear-guards.

[AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & retire two other rear-guards], and draw two cards. If this unit is on (VC), for every grade 1 card in your drop, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of battle.

[CONT](RC):If you have a vanguard with "Witch" in its card name, this unit cannot be chosen by your opponent's card effects, and it gets "Intercept" and [Power] +5000.

[CONT](VC):During your turn, all of your vanguards get [Power] +5000 for each of your opponent's grade 0 rear-guards.

[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if all of your (RC) have rear-guards, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], this unit gets [Power] +10000/[Critical] +1 until end of that battle, and if you have four or more cards in your damage zone, it gets drive +1.
